name: Aku no Onna Kanbu "Kono Watashi ni Oshioki da to!? Fuzakeruna!"
original_name: 悪の女幹部「この私にオシオキだと!? ふざけるなっ！」
source:
Katsuma is just a henchman of his female bosses... Whenever he does battle against Silva Star, a superhero, he loses...

One day, when he has another battle against Silva Star, his bosses suddenly spring a trap on Katsuma and Silva Star. When he regains his consciousness, he finds himself being taken care of by Maria, Silva Star's partner. Katsuma is attracted to her kindness... No, he just sleeps with her... However, he acquires a special power by sleeping with her...!

He soon decides to take revenge on his bosses...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
胜真只是几位女上司手下的一名喽啰…每次与超级英雄希尔瓦之星交手，他都会落败…

一天，他再次与希尔瓦之星交战时，上司们突然设下陷阱，将胜真和希尔瓦之星一同暗算。恢复意识后，他发现自己正受到希尔瓦之星的搭档玛丽亚照料。胜真被她的温柔吸引…不，他只是和她上了床…然而，与她交合后，他竟获得了一种特殊能力…！

不久后，他决定向上司们复仇…

[摘自ErogeShop]
